phases.name: Project Initialization & Storage Infrastructure
phases.description: Initialize project skeleton, configure TypeScript/Node.js build toolchain, install dependencies (better-sqlite3, minisearch), and implement SQLite storage engine with schema for memories, reflections, and session state. DB auto-creates on first write.

rough_tasks.title: Initialize project skeleton, TypeScript config, and install all dependencies
Implement SQLite storage layer with memory/reflection/session_state schemas and CRUD operations
Integrate BM25 search engine (minisearch) with storage layer for text indexing
Verify storage CRUD, DB auto-creation, BM25 search correctness, and retrieval latency < 100ms

phases.name: Intelligent Memory — Extraction, Conflict Detection, Retrieval & Injection
phases.description: Implement Layer 2: lazy memory extraction via LLM (GPT-4o-mini), memory conflict detection and upsert logic, tri-dimensional retrieval algorithm (recency + BM25 relevance + importance), and memory context injection into conversation via beforeTurn hook.

rough_tasks.title: Implement lazy memory extraction with LLM call, conflict detection upsert, and lazy-extraction-check algorithm
Implement tri-dimensional retrieval algorithm and memory/reflection injection into context
Wire beforeTurn hook to orchestrate lazy extraction check then memory injection
Verify extraction-to-injection pipeline: lazy extraction triggers, conflict upsert, retrieval scoring, and context injection

phases.name: Self-Learning — Reflection Generation & Injection
phases.description: Implement Layer 3: post-task reflection generation via LLM with signal-outcome resolution, reflection storage, BM25-based reflection retrieval, and reflection injection into subtask descriptions via beforeSpawn hook.

rough_tasks.title: Implement signal-outcome resolution, LLM reflection generation, and afterTask hook wiring
Implement reflection retrieval via BM25 and beforeSpawn hook injection into task descriptions
Verify reflection generation on task complete, signal resolution, and reflection injection into spawned tasks

phases.name: End-to-End Integration & System Verification
phases.description: Validate the complete LearnLoop pipeline end-to-end: beforeTurn triggers lazy extraction + memory injection, afterTask triggers reflection generation, beforeSpawn triggers reflection injection. Verify silent degradation on LLM failures, performance constraints, and OpenClaw plugin registration.

rough_tasks.title: Wire all 3 hooks into OpenClaw plugin entry point with unified configuration and error handling
End-to-end smoke test: full conversation lifecycle with memory extraction, retrieval, reflection, and injection

directory_structure.src/: Source root for all TypeScript modules
directory_structure.src/storage/: SQLite storage engine, schema definitions, migration logic
directory_structure.src/memory/: Memory extraction, conflict detection, retrieval, and injection
directory_structure.src/reflection/: Reflection generation, signal resolution, retrieval, and injection
directory_structure.src/hooks/: OpenClaw plugin hook handlers (beforeTurn, afterTask, beforeSpawn)
directory_structure.src/llm/: LLM client wrapper for GPT-4o-mini calls via OpenClaw proxy
directory_structure.src/config/: Configuration management (retrieval weights, LLM config, paths)
directory_structure.src/types/: Shared TypeScript type definitions (Memory, Reflection, SessionState)
directory_structure.test/fixtures/: Test fixtures (sample conversations, mock LLM responses)
